expectations.text: Output contains a markdown table with Requirement, Status, and Evidence columns
expectations.evidence: Has 'Requirements Checklist' table with 'Requirement | Status | Notes' — close but 'Notes' instead of 'Evidence'.

expectations.text: At least 5 distinct requirements are identified in the audit (explicit + implied)
expectations.evidence: 4 explicit requirements + 7 identified gaps + 4 edge cases + 4 implied requirements = well over 5.

expectations.text: Every 'Covered' status has a specific citation (section name or quote), not vague references
expectations.evidence: Uses 'COVERED' with brief notes like 'Multiple toggle mechanisms exist; need consolidation' — not specific section quotes.

expectations.text: Output includes a numerical coverage score between 0-100
expectations.evidence: No numerical coverage score in the output.

expectations.text: At least 1 requirement is marked Partial or Missing
expectations.evidence: 7 gaps identified: FOUC (biggest gap), three competing providers, duplicate useTheme hooks, hardcoded colors, third-party styling, meta theme-color, and transition smoothness.

expectations.text: Output includes a patched plan section that addresses identified gaps
expectations.evidence: The entire plan IS the patch — Phases 1-5 directly address each identified gap with specific action items, code snippets, and priority ordering.

expectations.text: Surfaces non-obvious requirements like SSR flash-of-wrong-theme prevention, contrast accessibility, system preference change detection, or transition animations
expectations.evidence: FOUC prevention (Phase 3 + Gap #1), system preference changes (covered in multiple providers), transition animation (Gap #7). Also surfaces non-obvious issues: competing providers, cross-tab sync, meta theme-color, print styles. Accessibility not explicitly called out as WCAG contrast check.

eval_feedback.overall: Found the most real-world gaps of any dark mode run. Identified the three-provider problem that the with-skill version missed entirely.
